data.reasoning: The package is a standard binary NVIDIA driver package that downloads from official NVIDIA servers (us.download.nvidia.com) with SHA-512 checksum verification. The PKGBUILD contains no top-level execution, no network calls during build/install beyond the pinned source download, and no suspicious commands. The disagreement was caused by an API error in the first model, not by any actual security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen3-235b model encountered an HTTP 400 error when attempting to audit .nvchecker.toml, resulting in an inconclusive verdict for that file and the overall package. The deepseek-v4-flash model successfully reviewed the same file and correctly identified it as a benign nvchecker configuration. The disagreement is purely a tool failure, not a substantive security disagreement.
